# Phase One — Revenue Engineering Without Fantasy

The Awtsmoos is beyond gain and measure; Awtsmoos.com should nevertheless build honest finite systems that increase the probability of sustainable revenue through real customer value.

## Seven Revenue Rivers
1. Acquisition: make every product crawlable, indexable, shareable, and understandable before JavaScript.
2. Activation: deep-link users directly into a useful example or workflow instead of a generic homepage.
3. Conversion: show live server-owned prices/capabilities with preserved work context through sign-in and checkout.
4. Paid value: make credits purchase durable delight or expensive incremental outcomes, never cripple basic usefulness.
5. Retention: recents, favorites, continue-working, saved projects, owned capabilities, and cross-product workflows.
6. Trust: receipts, reconciliation, accessibility, performance, privacy, failure recovery, and transparent cost testimony.
7. Measurement: privacy-safe funnel events and readiness scores so product decisions are based on evidence.

## Beyond The Immediate Seven
- Workflow bundles, team wallets, creator products, API/automation capacity, giftable value, seasonal cosmetic collections, referral attribution, and enterprise plans only after core reconciliation and observability are mature.
